title: Randy M NDE 4799
content: While scuba diving, I ran out of air and stopped breathing for five-plus minutes. During which time, I saw and spoke to my dead grandfather in a very bright light, after holding his hand and walking he let me go and said he would see me again in the future. I came to with the beating on my chest by a person on the dive boat, he had brought me up.
